d: Long, flowing honey-blonde hair with straight bangs and a sleek texture reaches down to the mid-back. Sharp, narrow light-blue eyes with a confident expression set a youthful and mature appearance. The build is slender with a lean physique. The outfit consists of a black military-style capelet with gold trim and gold buttons, a black high-waisted bottom, and thigh-high black stockings with gold accents and gold pointed toes. Signature details include a tall black shako hat with a white plume, a gold trumpet held in the hands, and gold chains draped across the chest.
